g.text: ERIKSON (exam pure — all 8!): trust → autonomy → initiative → industry → identity →
intimacy → generativity → integrity. Each crisis RESOLVED = virtue (hope, will, purpose,
competence, fidelity, love, care, wisdom); UNRESOLVED = carried wound. Illness REGRESSES:
hospitalised adults need trust (1) + autonomy (2) again — inform + offer choices!
NURSING PER STAGE: 1 consistent + warm (same nurse!) · 2 choices ("which arm?") · 3 praise
trying (stickers!) · 4 homework + "I can" tasks · 5 privacy + respect + peers · 6 partner
included · 7 mentor role ("teach the new mother!") · 8 life review + honour + legacy.
ADOLESCENCE (5): identity vs confusion — peers rule, risk tempts, privacy sacred. Counsel:
straight talk + confidentiality + choices + future-focus ("where's this taking you?"). Risk
behaviours = identity experiments — guide, never preach (COM M5!).
AGEING (8): integrity vs despair — "was my life good?" Life review THERAPY: photos,
stories, legacy ("what should grandchildren know?"). Despair signs: bitterness, "waste",
withdrawal → validate + connect + refer (GER M3/M6!). Honour = healing.
MIDLIFE (7): generativity vs stagnation — "am I needed?" Illness threatens purpose: involve
("your experience guides others!"), plan return-to-role, watch depression.
EXAM MOVE: "which stage?" — match age + task + quote behaviour ("toddler screaming 'me
do!' = autonomy!"). "Nursing care?" = stage-matched action. Always both halves.
LINKS: GER ageing · COM M5 lifespan · NUT lifecycle · PRO-I dignity.
MANTRA: "trust, try, make, master, me, us, guide, grace."
